segments.thag12.2:1.3: Hīnakammaṃ [hīnaṃ kammaṃ (syā.)] mamaṃ āsi, ahosiṃ pupphachaḍḍako.
segments.thag12.2:2.3: Nīcaṃ manaṃ karitvāna, vandissaṃ bahukaṃ janaṃ.
segments.thag12.2:6.3: ‘Ehi bhikkhū’ti maṃ āha, sā me āsūpasampadā.
segments.thag12.2:7.3: Akāsiṃ satthuvacanaṃ, yathā maṃ ovadī jino.
segments.thag12.2:8.3: Rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ, dibbacakkhuṃ visodhayiṃ [dibbacakkhu visodhitaṃ (ka.)];
segments.thag12.2:9.3: Indo brahmā ca āgantvā, maṃ namassiṃsu pañjalī.
segments.thag12.2:10.3: Yassa te āsavā khīṇā, dakkhiṇeyyosi mārisa’.
